770-2226-5921.notablePrerequisites:
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
770-2226-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Man-o'-War by paying its mana cost.
When Man-o'-War enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

2790-5669.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
Angel of Destiny does not have summoning sickness.
2790-5669.notablePrerequisites:
You control three nonbasic lands that share a type and will not have summoning sickness when animated.
Opponents cannot block flying creatures you control.
2790-5669.description:
Cast March from Velis Vel by paying its mana cost targeting Angel of Destiny, causing each nonbasic land you control of the chosen type to become a copy of the targeted creature until end of turn and granting them haste for that duration.
Move to combat and declare all your Angels as attackers, sending at least one Angel at each opponent.
When first strike damage is dealt, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers for each creature that dealt damage.
Resolve each trigger, causing each opponent to gain life equal to X times the damage they took (where X is the number of Angels you control) and you to gain life equal to that combined total.
Repeat steps 4-5 for the normal damage step.
At the beginning of your end step, since your life total is at least 45, each Angel of Destiny you control triggers, causing the player it attacked to lose the game.

Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
